about:
307 Clothing operates from Sheridan, Wyoming, where it was established in 2007. The business is a registered trademark of Stalick Brothers L.L.C., though the individual founders are not named in public materials. The website displays a copyright notice dated 2026.

The company sells a range of branded apparel and accessories through both a physical storefront known as the 307 Social Club and an e-commerce site powered by Shopify. Product categories include caps and hats (47 items), a Stealth Collection (6 items), general apparel (17 items), decals (31 items), hoodies (6 items), Excelsior Garage Originals (3 items), special discounts (4 items), and a commemorative Wyoming souvenir license plate (1 item). No details about manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

The brand markets directly to consumers via its website and retail location, with no specific industries or B2B customer segments identified in the available information. The product assortment suggests a focus on Wyoming-themed lifestyle and outdoor merchandise.

The company highlights its founding year of 2007 and its registered trademark status, but does not describe a specific founding mission or stated competitive advantage in the provided content.
